beats.beat: The CHILD wakes up early, excited and a little nervous: today is the first day of school.
The CHILD gets ready: new clothes, a new school bag, breakfast with the family.
The CHILD checks the school bag twice: pencils, a lunch box, and a favourite small toy for courage.
On the way to school the CHILD holds a parent's hand and notices the busy, friendly streets of the setting.
At the school gate the CHILD hesitates; the building looks very big.
The parent kneels down, hugs the CHILD and says something encouraging about being brave.
The kind teacher welcomes the CHILD with a warm smile and shows the classroom.
The classroom is full of colour: drawings on the walls, a reading corner, a plant by the window.
The CHILD sits next to another child who is also shy; they share a small smile.
During the lesson the CHILD answers a question and the teacher praises the answer.
At break time the CHILD and the new friend play together, connected to the CHILD's interests.
The two friends share their snacks and laugh about something funny that happened.
The CHILD draws a picture of the new friend and the school during the art activity.
When the parent comes to pick them up, the CHILD runs over proudly to show the drawing.
At home the CHILD happily says they cannot wait to go back to school tomorrow.
